---
title: "Lifetime Bounds on Traits"
---

# Lifetime Bounds on Traits
Constrain types with lifetime bounds, such as `T: 'a` (meaning `T` must outlive lifetime `'a`):

```rust
use std::fmt::Display;

fn print_ref<'a, T>(item: &'a T)
where
    T: Display + 'a,
{
    println!("Item: {}", item);
}
```
